task: Persist the connected proxy profile identity in ~/.codemie/proxy-connection.json so the claude-code-otlp hook cold start restarts the daemon with that profile, with a non-exiting SSO pre-check and the profile name in the Starting proxy output (EPMCDME-16321).

key_reasoning.reason: Touches daemon-manager (record constant, I/O, write in spawnDaemon), connect-orchestrator (ensureOtlpProxy, ensureDaemon message, verifySsoCredentials split), launch-daemon (second verifySsoCredentials consumer) and likely disconnect-orchestrator. verifySsoCredentials is a shared utility with process.exit semantics relied on by existing tests. All within the proxy command layer.

Acceptance criteria are clear, but the agreed design has open or contradicted points. Connect against an already-running matching daemon skips spawnDaemon, so no record is written. Disconnect semantics are unsettled (per-target, project scope, no Claude Desktop target). One record has many writers (proxy start and restart overwrite it). Upgrade behaviour with no record, same-named local profile overlay and project precedence are undecided.

Closest pattern is the readState/writeState tmp+rename code in daemon-manager.ts, but it does not cover record shape validation, an empty profile name falling back to the cwd profile, or ConfigLoader returning a normal-looking config for an unknown name. The change is credential and profile-selection sensitive (never start on another profile, non-exiting SSO check, no console output in hooks). The AC and design enumerate edge cases (missing, malformed, unloadable record) with no existing parameterized test template for them.

About 4-5 source files modified (daemon-manager, connect-orchestrator, launch-daemon, disconnect-orchestrator, possibly restart/docs), plus roughly 4-5 test files that need updates (connect-orchestrator, OtlpAgentAdapter, daemon-manager, hook-stdout integration, possibly index and disconnect tests), spread across src/cli/commands/proxy, __tests__, tests/integration and docs.
